reasons.plausibility: The hypothesis is scientifically sound: a DNN potential trained on ab initio liquid data should better capture many-body interactions and configurational diversity than a classical EAM, leading to improved phase-space overlap and reduced TI path mismatch.
reasons.testability: The proposed test is clear and decisive, comparing DNN and EAM references against ab initio benchmarks, but the falsification threshold (20% improvement) is somewhat arbitrary and the feasibility of full ab initio free-energy benchmarks for complex HEAs is challenging.
reasons.usefulness: This is a highly useful hypothesis that directly addresses the core limitation of TOR-TILD for high-entropy liquids, proposing a concrete, modern solution with a well-defined validation strategy.
